label: Formal fact: on an order of being by approach to a primary with strict…, by Model-construction
meaning: Part 1: from the order by approach and strict primacy the primary is more such than anything else, a fortiori than what it causes. Part 2: a three-being model (p nearest, then b, then a; a and b are creatures; p causes being in both, a causes being in b) satisfies the order by approach, strict primacy, the causal order of creatures to p, everything else being a creature and the broad genus principle, but a is not more a being than b.
